## 1. Decomposition with Residuals

$$
\delta x(t_1)
= \sum_i \delta x_i(t_1) + r.
$$

The residual term $r$ captures higher-order curvature effects.

## 2. Meaning of Residuals

Residuals quantify nonlinear coupling, not modeling error.

## 3. Validity Regime

Residual magnitude provides a natural error bound for attribution.
